mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, session_no, channel_id, customer_id, status, skill_group_id, agent_id, intent, emotion, source, start_time, end_time, csat_score, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM session WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND channel_id = #{channelId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1
